notes:
Diastema 0.32.0-beta.12 (beta)

This beta is everything Diastema has, in one build: the stable version (through 0.29.10) and every beta since. An office that switches from stable to beta gets it. With Open Dental, the office works the way it does today.

Changed since 0.32.0-beta.11

- Daily call list (Settings → Office emails): it's now an end-of-day list, the patients seen today, for calls after their visit such as post-operative calls. Same time order, providers, procedures, phones and note as before.
- It goes from the hour you pick until midnight, like the daily status report. It starts at 5:00 PM unless you pick another hour; an hour you already saved stays as you saved it, and you can still pick any hour of the day. If the server was off at that hour, it goes when the server is back the same day.
- On beta.9 through beta.11 a call list was never sent from 3:00 PM on, so an office that picked an afternoon or evening hour got none. It now goes at that hour.

Before you switch

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.10 or beta.11: no database update. This change needs no Diastema service update.

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.9: no database update. See the beta.10 notes for the birthday email.

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.1 through beta.8: a database update runs once at the first start and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v51"). It adds the list of office emails sent. Keep that copy.

Coming from stable: see the 0.32.0-beta.2 notes. A database update runs once at the first start and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v51"). Keep that copy.
